2: # Listens on $PORT, starts the user's app on an internal port, forwards requests
3: # only if they carry X-Small-Proxy: <per-app secret>. Everything else: 403.
4: # Usage: python guard.py <app command...>   ($PORT in the child resolves to the internal port)
5: # ponytail: full-buffer proxy for plain HTTP (no chunked streaming); websockets tunnel raw.
6: import http.client
7: import os
8: import socket
9: import subprocess
10: import sys
11: import threading
12: from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
13: 
14: SECRET = os.environ["SMALL_PROXY_SECRET"]
15: LISTEN_PORT = int(os.environ.get("PORT", "8080"))
16: APP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMALL_APP_PORT", "8090"))
17: HOP_HEADERS = {"connection", "keep-alive", "transfer-encoding", "content-length", "host", "x-small-proxy"}
18: 
19: 
20: def _pump(src, dst):
21:     try:
22:         while True:
23:             data = src.recv(65536)
24:             if not data:
25:                 break
26:             dst.sendall(data)
27:     except OSError:
28:         pass
29:     finally:
30:         for s in (src, dst):
31:             try:
32:                 s.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
33:             except OSError:
34:                 pass
35: 
36: 
37: class Guard(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
38:     protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
39: 
40:     def _handle(self):
41:         if self.headers.get("X-Small-Proxy") != SECRET:
42:             body = b"403 forbidden\n"
43:             self.send_response(403)
44:             self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
45:             self.end_headers()
46:             self.wfile.write(body)
47:             return
48:         if (self.headers.get("Upgrade") or "").lower() == "websocket":
49:             return self._websocket()
50:         length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
51:         body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else None
52:         headers = {k: v for k, v in self.headers.items() if k.lower() not in HOP_HEADERS}
53:         headers["Host"] = f"127.0.0.1:{APP_PORT}"
54:         if body is not None:
55:             headers["Content-Length"] = str(length)
56:         try:
57:             conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", APP_PORT, timeout=300)
58:             conn.request(self.command, self.path, body=body, headers=headers)
59:             resp = conn.getresponse()
60:             data = resp.read()
61:         except OSError:
62:             data = b"502 app not responding\n"
63:             self.send_response(502)
64:             self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
65:             self.end_headers()
66:             self.wfile.write(data)
67:             return
68:         self.send_response(resp.status)
69:         for k, v in resp.getheaders():
70:             if k.lower() not in HOP_HEADERS:
71:                 self.send_header(k, v)
72:         self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
73:         self.end_headers()
74:         if self.command != "HEAD":
75:             self.wfile.write(data)
76:         conn.close()
77: 
78:     # Replays the upgrade request to the app, then tunnels raw bytes both ways.
79:     # Client may not send frames before the 101 lands (RFC 6455), so nothing is
80:     # stuck in rfile's buffer when we switch to the raw socket.
81:     def _websocket(self):
82:         self.close_connection = True
83:         try:
84:             upstream = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", APP_PORT), timeout=5)
85:         except OSError:
86:             self.send_response(502)
87:             self.end_headers()
88:             return
89:         upstream.settimeout(None)
90:         lines = [f"{self.command} {self.path} HTTP/1.1", f"Host: 127.0.0.1:{APP_PORT}"]
91:         for k, v in self.headers.items():
92:             if k.lower() not in ("host", "x-small-proxy"):
93:                 lines.append(f"{k}: {v}")
94:         upstream.sendall(("\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n").encode("latin-1"))
95:         t = threading.Thread(target=_pump, args=(upstream, self.connection), daemon=True)
96:         t.start()
97:         _pump(self.connection, upstream)
98:         t.join()

100:     do_GET = do_POST = do_PUT = do_DELETE = do_PATCH = do_HEAD = do_OPTIONS = _handle
101: 
102:     def log_message(self, *args):
103:         pass

106: def main():
107:     if len(sys.argv) < 2:
108:         sys.exit("usage: guard.py <app command...>")
109:     env = dict(os.environ, PORT=str(APP_PORT))
110:     proc = subprocess.Popen(sys.argv[1:], env=env)
111:     server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", LISTEN_PORT), Guard)
112:     threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
113:     code = proc.wait()  # app dies -> guard exits -> platform restarts container
114:     server.shutdown()
115:     sys.exit(code)

18: # Minimal ws echo server: HTTP 101 handshake, then echo one masked text frame back unmasked.
19: ECHO_WS_APP = """

23: srv = socket.socket()
24: srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)

30:     while b"\\r\\n\\r\\n" not in data:
31:         data += conn.recv(4096)

33:     accept = base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha1(key + GUID.encode()).digest())
34:     conn.sendall(b"HTTP/1.1 101 Switching Protocols\\r\\nUpgrade: websocket\\r\\n"
35:                  b"Connection: Upgrade\\r\\nSec-WebSocket-Accept: " + accept + b"\\r\\n\\r\\n")
36:     hdr = conn.recv(2)
37:     n = hdr[1] & 0x7F
38:     mask = conn.recv(4)
39:     payload = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(conn.recv(n)))
40:     conn.sendall(bytes([0x81, len(payload)]) + payload)
41:     conn.close()
42: """

45: def ws_roundtrip(message):
46:     key = base64.b64encode(os.urandom(16))
47:     sock = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", PORT), timeout=5)
48:     sock.sendall(
49:         b"GET /ws HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\n"
50:         b"Sec-WebSocket-Key: " + key + b"\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\n"
51:         b"X-Small-Proxy: " + SECRET.encode() + b"\r\n\r\n"
52:     )
53:     resp = b""
54:     while b"\r\n\r\n" not in resp:
55:         resp += sock.recv(4096)
56:     assert b"101" in resp.split(b"\r\n")[0], f"handshake failed: {resp!r}"
57:     want = base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha1(key + WS_GUID.encode()).digest())
58:     assert want in resp, "Sec-WebSocket-Accept mismatch"
59:     mask = os.urandom(4)
60:     masked = bytes(b ^ mask[i % 4] for i, b in enumerate(message))
61:     sock.sendall(bytes([0x81, 0x80 | len(message)]) + mask + masked)
62:     hdr = sock.recv(2)
63:     echoed = sock.recv(hdr[1] & 0x7F)
64:     sock.close()
65:     return echoed
